pages.text: $(bold)Curse Core$() is the foundation of the Cursed Energy system. It is a Tinkers' Construct tool worn in the $(bold)curios Curse Core slot$(), providing:$(li)Cursed Energy capacity and regeneration$(li)Techniques ($(l:techniques/yuchuzi)Shrine$()/$(l:techniques/blood_manipulation)Blood Manipulation$(), etc.)$(li)Domains ($(l:domains/zuosha_botu)Idle Death Gamble$()/$(l:domains/wuliang_kongchu)Unlimited Void$()/$(l:domains/fumo_yuchuzi)Malevolent Shrine$())$(li)Material combat traits (active depending on the core's material)

Cores can only be obtained through the $(l:basics/ritual)Curse Core Ritual$() and cannot be hand-assembled on a crafting table.$(br2)A core produced by the ritual randomly rolls a $(bold)Cursed Energy Reserve$() level and a $(bold)Cursed Output$() level (1–5), comes with one random Technique trait and one Domain trait, and has a 30% chance to gain an extra Technique slot (up to 3).

$(bold)Smelting recovery$(): since a Curse Core is a Tinkers' Construct tool, it can be thrown directly into the $(bold)Smeltery or Foundry$() to be melted down into $(bold)the fluid of its material$() (e.g. a Rose Gold core → Molten Rose Gold).$(br2)Unwanted cores can be burned to reclaim their materials, or kept for $(l:techniques/transfer)Technique / Domain Transfer$().
